card.headline: *ael* on top after six.
card.deck: Five wins from six for the Limassol side. Omonia, Pafos and APOEL have a game in hand.
card.footnote: Table after the games of 17 and 18 October.

caption:
AEL Limassol are top of the Cyprus League after six rounds: five wins, one defeat, 15 points.

AEK Larnaca sit two behind on 13. Apollon Limassol are third on 12 and still unbeaten. Omonia (11), Pafos (10) and APOEL (7) have all played a game fewer than the leaders.

Table after the games of 17 and 18 October. 🇨🇾

Source: Cyprus Football Association
